headline.caveat: >$500B combined target across all six financiers, subject to final agreements; no per-firm allocation disclosed

nature_md: Brookfield is one of six financiers in NVIDIA's Aug 10, 2026 coalition targeting >$500B of third-party capital for compute-collateralized SPV financing of AI infrastructure. Brookfield brings the power-and-real-assets angle: co-owner of Westinghouse (the $80B US-government nuclear partnership), a €20B French AI-infrastructure program, and a $5B Bloom Energy fuel-cell order pipeline. Per-firm commitments undisclosed; agreements are MOUs.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Prospective deployment of client capital via Brookfield Asset Management infrastructure/credit funds — fee-earning AUM, with possible principal co-investment from Brookfield Corporation; nothing booked at MOU stage.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Target capitalization for platforms not yet funded; >$500B is aspirational pending final agreements.
